; Formes : (1) journalise le contenu de gestureData des formes natives (SnapHandler)
;          (2) accroche rechargeable à chaud dans DeviceSceneView : /home/root/xovi/crayons/Formes.qml
;              rechargé quand /home/root/xovi/crayons/formes.version change ; reçoit la vue (controller, etc.)
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SnapHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE ShapesOverlay
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            onGestureDataChanged: {
                try {
                    const o = {};
                    for (const k in gestureData) {
                        const v = gestureData[k];
                        o[k] = (v !== null && typeof v === "object") ? (String(v) + " {" + Object.keys(v).join(",") + "}") : v;
                    }
                    console.log("FORMES gestureData " + JSON.stringify(o));
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log("FORMES gestureData erreur " + e);
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: formesAccroche
                property int version: 0
                Timer {
                    interval: 1000
                    repeat: true
                    running: root.visible
                    onTriggered: {
                        const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                        x.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/crayons/formes.version", false);
                        try {
                            x.send();
                            const v = parseInt(x.responseText) || 0;
                            if (v !== formesAccroche.version) {
                                formesAccroche.version = v;
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                        }
                    }
                }
                Loader {
                    id: formesLoader
                    source: "file:///home/root/xovi/crayons/Formes.qml?v=" + formesAccroche.version
                    onLoaded: item.view = root
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
